title: Update the Claude Code pin to 2.1.299
summary: Change the pinned Claude Code version from 2.1.296 to 2.1.299 in athena.toml (claude_version) and in the current-state docs that quote the pin. Historical review records and test fixtures that merely use a version string are left alone.

defaults_applied.how: Found the pin in athena.toml and the docs quoting it by searching the repository.
One focused version bump; history and fixtures untouched.
athena.toml is a governance file, so it is a named deliverable and criterion.
Update every live reference to the pin, not just the config.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: 2.1.299 is a real published npm release of @anthropic-ai/claude-code; the verifier cannot check this offline.
Test fixtures using "2.1.296" as an arbitrary version string need not change, as they are self-contained.
Historical review documents stay at 2.1.296 as dated evidence.
No checksum or other pin sits beside claude_version that needs updating.

acceptance_criteria.text: athena.toml sets claude_version = "2.1.299" and no other key in athena.toml changes.
README.md and docs/design/athena-v0.md (setup and pin table lines) and docs/decisions.md line about the pin name 2.1.299 as the current pin.
Review/acceptance documents under docs/design/reviews/ are unchanged, since they record what was tested at 2.1.296.
Run `cargo test` and `cargo clippy` and `cargo fmt --check`: all pass with the new pin.

out_of_scope: Changing Claude Code flags or behavior for the new version
departures: A mechanical version bump is cheaper than the typical job, so the cost and wall time are lower than the reference.
